title: Network security controls between the cardholder data environment and everything else
Secure configuration of system components, and removal of vendor defaults
Protection of account data where it is stored, including retention limits and key management
notes: The requirement most affected by scope: if the primary account number never lands in the system, most of this falls away.

title: Protection of cardholder data in transit across open, public networks
Protection of systems and networks from malicious software
Development and maintenance of secure systems and software, including patching
Restriction of access to system components and cardholder data by business need to know
Identification of users and authentication of access to system components
Restriction of physical access to cardholder data
notes: Inherited from the provider for a hosted service, and the provider's own attestation of compliance is the evidence.

title: Logging of access to system components and cardholder data, and monitoring of those logs
notes: The retention period is fixed by the standard rather than left to the organisation, which is where AU-11 differs.

title: Regular testing of the security of systems and networks
An organisational information security policy and programme supporting the above
